parallels.note: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

translations.web: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
translations.bsb: But Jesus gave no answer, not even to a single charge, much to the governor’s amazement.
translations.kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
translations.asv: And he gave him no answer, not even to one word: insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
